title: Scanned Symbol at the Right Boundary
statement: For every bit string $x$, optional control state $q$ among the six states or the halting state, and output string $w$, a configuration whose input head is at the right boundary, position $|x|+1$, scans no symbol.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ is an optional state among the six states
replaced:
For the six-state diagonal pairing machine on an input string $x$, in any
configuration whose input head sits at the right boundary position
$|x| + 1$, the scanned input symbol is the blank, for every control state and
every output string --- including on the empty input.
